title: Monument B1: The podium bridge, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Monument B1 (The podium bridge). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): Your first equipment has arrived: a battery, for the dash. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff now use it to watch the road. Today you join the road. Dash into a colleague. Farsight will time you.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): Battery 1 is fitted, for the dash. Shoppers never came to the podium bridge; staff now watch from it as you dash into a colleague, toward Certification.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
